title: Quote: (about the Apple Cafeteria) This is the nicest corporate caf...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: Apple and Pixar: Steve's Two Jobs
content: (about the Apple Cafeteria) This is the nicest corporate cafe I've ever seen. When we got here this was dog food. There was this company called Guggeinheim that it was farmed out to and it was just shit. And finally we fired them and got this friend of mine who runs Il Fourniao restaurant to come and he did everything and now it's great.
full_transcript: (about the Apple Cafeteria) This is the nicest corporate cafe I've ever seen. When we got here this was dog food. There was this company called Guggeinheim that it was farmed out to and it was just shit. And finally we fired them and got this friend of mine who runs Il Fourniao restaurant to come and he did everything and now it's great.
